source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
With **ADEPTA SORORITAS** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), each of your units that has this ability can carry out an Act of Faith once per phase, by spending Miracle dice.

You get a Miracle die:

- as each turn begins
- whenever an **ADEPTA SORORITAS** unit of yours is **destroyed**

Whenever you get one, roll a D6: the result is that die's value, which stays fixed, with no change or re-roll, unless a rule allows one. Set your gained dice aside as your Miracle dice pool.

Before you roll dice for one of your models or units that has this ability, if your pool holds any Miracle dice, that unit can carry out an Act of Faith: pick a die from the pool to stand in for a die of that roll. Then:

- if the roll uses more than one die, such as for a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) or [Charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step), only one of them can be swapped
- the swapped die is not rolled; the Miracle die's value counts as its unmodified result
- each Miracle die can be picked just once; after every swap is made, take the picked dice out of your pool and roll the rest

An Act of Faith can stand in for any of these rolls: [Advance](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), [Charge](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step), Damage, [Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls), [saving throw](vsdata:core-rule/save-rolls) and [Wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) rolls.
